footer.offline: Runs on this Mac. Nothing leaves it.

home.headline: Hold <keys/> and talk.
home.lede: Let go and your words land in whatever app you're in — without the ums, the restarts, or the “no wait, I mean”.

status.off: Cleanup is off — raw transcripts paste as spoken
status.down: Ollama isn't running — pasting raw transcripts

speak.title: Speak
speak.body: Mandarin, English, French — mixed in one sentence is fine.

clean.title: Clean
clean.body: A local model trims fillers and fixes punctuation. Never translates.

paste.title: Paste
paste.body: If cleanup takes longer than {{seconds}} s, the raw text goes in instead.

last.timed_out: Last dictation → {{app}} hit the {{seconds}} s budget — pasted as spoken.

command.label: Command mode
command.body: Select text, hold <keys/> and say what to do with it. Let go — the selection is replaced. Nothing selected? It writes at the cursor.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.lede: A local Ollama model tidies each dictation before it's pasted. Your words, minus the noise.

enabled.label: Clean up dictations
enabled.note: Off pastes exactly what the speech model heard.

model.label: Model
model.note: Any model you've pulled into Ollama.
model.down: Ollama isn't reachable. Start it with “ollama serve”.

budget.label: Time budget
budget.note: Past this, the raw transcript is pasted and the model's answer is dropped.

server.label: Ollama
server.note: Loopback only. Remote hosts are refused.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.lede: Names, jargon, words the recogniser keeps getting wrong. Terms steer Whisper before it listens; “heard as” fixes what slips through, before and after cleanup.
dictionary.addPlaceholder: Add a word, name or acronym
dictionary.empty: Nothing yet. Start with the word you correct most.

styles.title: Styles
styles.lede: L.O.B.A notices where you're typing. Chats stay loose, email gets buttoned up, code and terminals get exactly what you said.
styles.literalNote: No model pass. Dictionary fixes only — commands and code arrive exactly as spoken.
styles.appsNote: Matched by app name or bundle id.
styles.titlesNote: When the app itself isn't listed, a window title containing this word decides — Gmail in Safari reads as email.
